description: This file defines a class 'MessagePackCodecOptions' which encapsulates various configuration options for the 'MessagePackCodec' serializer in the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It includes properties for serializer options, a flag for data contract attributes, and delegates to determine if types are serializable or copyable.

classes.name: MessagePackCodecOptions
classes.description: A class providing configuration options for MessagePack serialization within Orleans.

methods.name: MessagePackCodecOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing serializer options to 'Standard'.
